EmailTemplate.name: User Group Notice 10/08/14
EmailTemplate.subject: ASU Salesforce User Group
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Monthly Salesforce User Group
Beginning on November 5, 2014, the ASU Salesforce Enterprise team will hold monthly user groups open to all Salesforce users.
Each user group will cover updates and questions from:
Service Recruitment Knowledge Training
The team will present information on recent and upcoming releases, user interface tips, troubleshooting, system updates and chatter.
SAVE THE DATE Wednesday, November 5, 2014 at 10 am CPCOM 120
COMING SOON: Salesforce updates and future user group announcements will be posted to Chatter groups. Users will automatically be added to the Service, Recruitment or Knowledge chatter groups.
Questions? Contact Salesforce Support at salesforce.support@asu.edu.
